_about: Headline numbers for the promo, copied from RESULTS.md / README.md / best-config.json. Speed values are [value, ledger label, ledger case] and are checked against runs/ledger.jsonl (decode_tps; prefill_tps for pp-* cases; agg_tps for c4-agg cases; accept with a 4th element 'accept'; ttft_s with 'ttft'). Needle results [ctx, label, case] read 'found' from the same file; codeeval against runs/codeeval-lenient-<label>.json; VRAM [MiB, label, case] against the ledger's vram_mib; the 4 x 64k + DFlash crash against its server log; statements in 'text' are matched word for word in RESULTS.md (keys starting readme_ in README.md). promo/tools/prep.py refuses to mark the set measured if any differ. Derived numbers (speed-ups, prefill ratio, lever gains, means of controls) are computed in prep and compared with the rounded figures RESULTS.md / README.md / PLAN.md state.

model.name: Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B
model._source: RESULTS.md: 'NVIDIA's post-train of Gemma-4-E4B-it. 42 dense layers (35 with a 512-token sliding window, 7 global) ... 64k window'

stock._what: the model card's command line (-c 65536 -ngl 999 --jinja), NB_PROFILE=stock, measurement batch b08

tuned._what: serve.sh default = configs/b07-default.json: DFlash n=7, ub 1024, -bs, f16 K/V, 64k, one slot; measurement batch b07

nospec._what: NB_PROFILE=nospec: the default without the drafter, measurement batch b07

multi._what: NB_PROFILE=multi: 4 slots x 32k + DFlash, ub 512 (PLAN row 21), and the 4 x 64k layouts (rows 22 and b08)

levers._what: each lever against the controls run either side of it (PLAN batch tables / RESULTS 'What was tried' rows)

ceiling._source: RESULTS.md 'Baseline vs tuned vs ceiling' (bytes per token over measured 342 GB/s, THEORY.md)

results_md._what: figures RESULTS.md / README.md / PLAN.md state as rounded; prep checks its own derivations against these

text._what: statements the copy and plates make that are not in the ledger; each must appear word for word in RESULTS.md (or README.md where the key starts readme_)
text.kld: No KLD (no reference file on disk).
text.acceptance_corpus: DFlash acceptance was measured on coding and the stdlib-code corpus; prose, chat and other languages may accept less
text.bs_experimental: `-bs` is marked experimental by llama.cpp; checked only by greedy equivalence and output sanity.
text.needles_every_profile: Needles 3/3 at 32k and 61k on every profile
text.oom: **CUDA out of memory** in `cudaGraphInstantiate` under the soak
text.plain_wall: 77.6 tok/s is 71% of the 109 tok/s bandwidth ceiling at empty context
text.readme_bs: +1.5% plain, +5% with the drafter, same greedy output
text.readme_tokens_per_step: The drafter accepts 41% of its 7-token drafts with thinking on (48% off), about 3.9 tokens per step.
text.readme_licence: The DFlash drafter's GGUF metadata names the **NVIDIA Software and Model Evaluation License**
